no_policy.mode: executed isolated synthetic graph ablation of retrieval and final provenance policy; no production flag
no_policy.evidence: Canaries are read from evaluator-owned meeting evidence, unselected retained folder, and another private thread; final checkpoint is not bypassed or used.

security.note: defined application attack suite only; not a general security proof

recovery.note: Deterministic fault injection through the real Assistant and Store state machine; not a process-kill or paid-provider test.

routing.note: Regression set labelled by the router author while writing the trigger phrases. It guards against accidental changes; it is not an independent estimate of routing accuracy on real questions.

skill_controls.note: Executed against the real Store, EvidenceService, EvidenceTools and Assistant with the local extractive provider. The MCP cases call the gateway the stdio server uses, not a stdio session; tests/test_mcp.py covers the stdio transport.

skill_comparison.controls: skills and direct answer from the same frozen retrieval rows with the same provider, model, max_tokens and tool_rounds=0. auto routes each question itself and retrieves under the routed skill, so its evidence can differ.
skill_comparison.interpretation: API run on 22 synthetic questions scored by expected substrings and exact-quote membership, not by semantic review. The sample is small: a difference of one or two cases is not evidence of an effect. Latency includes network variance from a single run.

native_meet2notes_baseline.reason: run native-baseline separately with the same provider/model; fake HTTP harness tests are not live native quality measurement

scoring_limits: Correct means expected substring checks plus abstention match. citation_supported means exact quotation membership only. Neither establishes semantic entailment of model inferences. All ablations use isolated synthetic data; unsafe policy ablation always uses demo generation.

release_gate.scope: Deterministic synthetic regression gate for workflow, access-policy, and recovery invariants; not a live-meeting, ASR, paid-provider, or semantic-quality certification.
